main_text.p: Martyres plerique alacriter supplicia sustinuerint, &jugulum carnificib. ul-tro praebuerint, nonnulli etiam in me-diis flammis hymnos laeti cecinerint: quia scilicet omnes tempestates & flu-ctus irae Dei in se effusum iri praesentie-bat. Psal. 22. Jes. 53. Matth. 27.

Intercessio Christi Sa-cerdotisII. Ipse deinde summus Sacerdos, partim paulo ante oblationem pro nobis oravit (Johan. 17.) Patrem, ut scilicet satisfactionem illam suam credentibus imputaret: Partim vero, posteaquam ex mortuis excitatus, in coelum ascendit, atque ita in SANCTUARIUM illud non manufactum ingressus est, victimamque semel in terris oblatam in illum intulit, continenter coram facie Patris pro nobis apparet, (Heb. 9. 24.) & se, ac victimam illi ostendens, vigore illius semel oblati, perpetuo pro nobis interpellat. Rom. 8. 34.
Quamobrem, sicut Pontifex legalis populum suum typice expiabat, & pro eo orabat: Lev. 4. &5.[?] & 6. & 9. & 16. &c. Sic Christus summus noster Pontifex, purgatione peccatorum nostrorum per se ipsum

page.notes: The third paragraph breaks off at the foot of the page and continues on the next page. The "&5.[?]" in the Leviticus reference is an unclear character, probably a long-s "s" or "5". The left marginal note is split across three lines with a hyphen after "Sa-". The second paragraph's marginal note is printed in a smaller, bolder type. No catchword or signature is visible.
